# `kv` standard library

The `kv` module implements a Bitcask-inspired embedded log-structured
key-value store. Writes append CRC-32-protected records to an append-only log
file while maintaining an in-memory `KeyDir` (`String ^ EntryLoc`) that maps
every live key to its exact file offset and byte length for $O(1)$ single-seek
reads. It also provides online log compaction (`compact`) and `#!` compile-time
structural typed serialization (`put_val`, `get_val`) powered by `std/binary`.

```{.dva .run}
#use kv
#use libc
#use io

path = "/tmp/edva_doc_kv_demo.kv"
libc::unlink(path)
db = kv::open(path)!!
kv::put(db, "greeting", "Hello from std/kv!") !| _
io::out $ (kv::get(db, "greeting") | s => s | "")
kv::close(db)
libc::unlink(path)
```

## Types & function catalog

| Symbol / Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kv::Store` | `(path: String, fd: Int, pos: Int, keydir: KeyDir)` | Handle to an open log-structured key-value store |
| `kv::open(path)` | `String => < Store | Error >` | Opens or creates a persistent KV store at `path` and replays its log |
| `kv::close(db)` | `Store => <>` | Closes the underlying file descriptor of `db` |
| `kv::len(db)` | `Store => Int` | Number of live keys currently in `db` |
| `kv::has(db, key)` | `Store, String => <>` | Returns `<+>` if `key` is present in `db` |
| `kv::put(db, key, val)` | `Store, String, String => < | Error >` | Appends a CRC-32-verified `key -> val` record and updates `keydir` |
| `kv::get(db, key)` | `Store, String => < String | Error >` | Reads the value for `key` (`Error` if missing or on I/O failure) |
| `kv::get_opt(db, key)` | `Store, String => < String | >` | Reads the value for `key` if present (`<-->` if missing) |
| `kv::delete(db, key)` | `Store, String => < <> | Error >` | Appends a deletion tombstone for `key` and removes it from `keydir` |
| `kv::keys(db)` | `Store => String{}` | Returns all live keys in sorted lexicographical order |
| `kv::compact(db)` | `Store => < | Error >` | Rewrites only live entries to a new log file and atomically replaces `db.path` |
| `kv::put_val(db, key, val)` | `#! T: Type, Store, String, T => < | Error >` | Encodes `val` via `binary::encode_le` and stores it under `key` |
| `kv::get_val(T, db, key)` | `#! T: Type, Store, String => < T | Error >` | Reads and decodes a value of type `T` stored under `key` |
